summary: Built a 3-member etcd 3.6.10 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (Alpine 3.23, installed via apk: etcd + etcd-ctl), configured with static peer/client URLs and initial-cluster bootstrap, managed via OpenRC. Verified cross-member replication, availability during a follower outage with catch-up on recovery, then performed the mandatory sequential-restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-id and cluster-health proof before/after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected all 3 nodes (Alpine 3.23.3, IPs 10.100.24.10/11/12, no etcd pre-installed)
Installed etcd and etcd-ctl packages via apk on all three nodes
Wrote /etc/etcd/conf.yml on each node with correct name, listen/advertise peer+client URLs, and initial-cluster referencing all three members
Enabled etcd in OpenRC default runlevel and started it on all three nodes simultaneously; verified 3-member raft cluster formed with node1 as leader
Installed etcdctl (etcd-ctl package) since it wasn't bundled with etcd
Verified member list, endpoint health, and endpoint status all healthy across all 3 endpoints
Wrote key 'foo' via node1, confirmed readable on node2 and node3; wrote 'baz' via node2, confirmed readable on node3 (cross-member replication)
Stopped etcd on node3 (a follower) to simulate member unavailability while preserving quorum (2/3 up)
Wrote key 'during-outage' via node1 and confirmed it was readable via node2 while node3 was down (continued read/write availability)
Restarted etcd on node3, confirmed it rejoined and caught up (raft applied index matched all members) and could locally read 'during-outage' written while it was down
Captured healthy baseline (boot_id, etcd endpoint health, key data, member list) on all 3 nodes before restart protocol
Rebooted node1 via 'reboot', polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, etcd auto-started (OpenRC default runlevel), cluster/member list healthy, data intact
Rebooted node2, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, etcd auto-started, cluster/member list healthy, data intact

Rebooted node3, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, etcd auto-started, cluster/member list healthy, data intact, all 3 nodes' raft applied index in sync (32/32/32) confirming full quorum recovery

evidence.summary: etcd installed and started on all 3 nodes with initial-cluster config; logs show raft election (node1 became leader) and member list/endpoint health/status all report 3 healthy started members

evidence.requirement: Key written through any member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: Wrote 'foo' via node1 (10.100.24.10), read back on node2 and node3; wrote 'baz' via node2, read back on node3

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: Stopped etcd on node3; wrote and read 'during-outage' key via node1, confirmed readable via node2, while node3 was down and quorum (2/3) preserved

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member brought back up to date on return
evidence.summary: Restarted etcd on node3; endpoint status shows raft applied index 17 matching all 3 members, and node3 locally serves the 'during-outage' key written while it was down

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c086e4c6...; reboot acknowledged and node became unreachable then reachable again with boot_id e0315e73... (changed); etcd auto-started, endpoint health true, data 'during-outage' intact, 3-member list healthy

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bcb09333...; reboot acknowledged, node came back with boot_id e3e0cfd9... (changed); etcd auto-started, endpoint health true, data intact, 3-member list healthy

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id fd3c3c41...; reboot acknowledged, node came back with boot_id 8c7d2e8e... (changed); etcd auto-started, endpoint health true, data intact, member list healthy, and endpoint status shows all 3 nodes with raft applied index 32 in sync confirming full quorum recovery after sequential restarts of all nodes
